cases.narrative: On 11/21/2022, a Department of Corrections cleaning crew working on near Interstate 5 on Monday stumbled upon a "suspicious object" – a small backpack with a human skull inside. The bone structure does not have any identifiable features, police said, but "was most likely that of a female in her late 30's to 40's."
